title: Translation of an affine subspace indicator
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbf F_2)^n$ and let $a\in(\mathbf F_2)^n$. For every $x\in(\mathbf F_2)^n$, the indicator of the affine subspace $a+H$ at $x$ equals the indicator of $H$ at $x+a$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $(\mathbf F_2)^n$
the equality holds as functions, hence for every $x\in(\mathbf F_2)^n$
